Wx.bar_b_note: A big, naturalistic plated turtle with a clear silhouette, well above the ruler, and a faint that reads; the plating values are a little busy at small size.

Fn.bar_b_note: The thin neon magenta and violet streamers read more like a glow effect than a creature body, and at 30% the head is the only readable mass.

Us.bar_b_note: A large, clean long-necked silhouette with a strong cyan/navy water-type read that dwarfs the ruler; the glossy spotted surface is slightly toy-like next to the owner bar.

Ki.bar_b_note: The dark brown body and black-and-yellow speckled back sit in one muddy mid-dark value, so the face and form get lost; a thin stray spike sticks up above the back in faint mid and faint end.

Wj.bar_b_note: Blurry, smeared ground and wall textures, a desaturated grade and flat lighting sink it well below the key art and Palworld, whichever aftermath logic is used.

Aa.bar_b_note: The furry otter/beaver reaches the owner's naturalistic fur bar and its poses read, but standing it is only about as tall as the 1.80 m trainer.

Ly.bar_b_note: A big, readable blue frog with a good value split between back and belly; faint mid and faint end stay nearly upright, so the faint barely reads.

Td.bar_b_note: B's mottled, scaled serpent with an open-mouth threat pose and a grounded coiled faint is on-bar, but A's flat, untextured yellow-black material and its faint mid/end bodies floating high above their shadows sink the set.

Ta.bar_b_note: A long, low, dark-violet lizard whose back stays below the trainer's head and whose dark values give a weak face and silhouette at small size.

Jr.bar_b_note: An appealing, clearly characterised elder villager with readable eyes and an earthy green/brown palette that fits the key art's people, though he is more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures.

Nz.bar_b_note: The naturalistic bristled boar matches the owner style, but standing it reaches only about the trainer's height and its single tan value flattens the face.

Ds.bar_b_note: A large, readable blue dragon with a crest and fin accents and good scale against the ruler; in the ridden frame no rider is clearly visible at this size.

Bo.bar_b_note: A strong armoured spiked silhouette with a pale belly that separates its values; the swimming frame's flat opaque blue water slab, with the trainer standing on it, looks like a placeholder.

Cm.bar_b_note: The dark owl/raven has convincing feather detail and readable faint poses, but it is barely taller than the trainer and its near-black plumage hides the face.

Qy.bar_b_note: A's braced timber frame, cap and stone footing start to read as built, but it is still a lone, thin panel with flat untextured infill, beside a faceted pale stand-in rock and blurry ground.

top_changes.change: Rebuild the Meadows ground and structure materials and grade (sharp, saturated grass/dirt textures, warm key light with real shadows and blue distance) so the Wj and Qy world frames approach the key art.

Scale the undersized creatures (Aa, Nz, Cm, Ta) so they clearly stand taller than the 1.80 m trainer, and lift the values of the dark ones (Ki, Ta, Cm) with rim light and lighter face and eye accents.

Make the homestead wall a thick timber-and-plaster wall section with textured infill and a proper footing, and give each trainer site its own authored aftermath props instead of removed or toppled generic pieces.
